scope: 42 one-shot cost observations; 4 packing observations; 4 instrumented profile/census runs. No strict all-root equivalence or exclusive peak-performance claim.

measurement.per_point: One fresh process, one reset warmup, one reset measured step; no profiling/census counters in formal cost interval.
measurement.lh: IEEE FP32; SGD lr1e-5,momentum0.3, loss1e-6 sum_port(cG)^2. Interval includes input generation/upload, packing, forward, finite checks, backward/SGD if training, cleanup and sync. Construction/hash/reset outside. No TTFT.
measurement.fc: Existing downstream task; inference includes last-position head/argmax and actual warm-loaded TTFT; grad-forward/training use full head/loss. Training includes embedding/core/readout/head/loss/finite/backward/clip/AdamW/cleanup/sync.
measurement.comparison: Direct/public/default responsibilities differ (dense versus selected Full, raw/observation duties). Transformer16 is a different function. Deltas localize a gap, not pure scheduler or solver overhead.
measurement.report: Seconds, actual distinct input positions/seconds, measured TTFT only for FC inference, requested/effective path/precision, candidate/Full/message counts, peak memory, shared-resource context, strict numerical and restore statuses separately.

launch.affinity_note: Parent may allocate other currently available disjoint pools; record requested and actual affinity/NUMA/ATen/BLAS. One multi-thread setting (32), no thread sweep.

npu.queue_scope: Ordinary asynchronous single-device path. Record requested/effective queue options; no launch-blocking or peer-queue successor substitution.
npu.admission: Use current conversation scope and site cooperative admission; capture physical/logical identity, processes, free HBM, utilization and contention. Never assume a card from old logs.

launch.ordering: Within each device run neighboring direct/public/default/PyTorch modes sequentially; CPU/NPU may use disjoint pools if host memory/IO is quiet, with concurrent work recorded. Qualification/profiling separately from timing.
